# apicp_mail_settings (Resource)

The mail server's server-wide settings on apicp's control-plane node. Requires an admin-tier provider token. One per server: declare it once. Destroying it puts apicp's defaults back (`default_max_message_size_mb`, weak password schemes off); it never leaves the server without a value. Needs apicp after v0.6.18.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The mail server's server-wide settings. One per server.
resource "apicp_mail_settings" "this" {
  # The largest message accepted, incoming and outgoing (0 = unlimited). 50 MB lets through
  # attachments up to roughly 36 MB (encoding adds about a third).
  max_message_size_mb = 50

  # Only while mailboxes moved from an older server still have its MD5-crypt (or similar) password
  # hashes: Dovecot 2.4 refuses those logins otherwise. Back to false (the default) once they have
  # new passwords.
  # allow_weak_password_schemes = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_message_size_mb` (Number) Largest message the mail server accepts, incoming and outgoing (Postfix `message_size_limit`), in MB (1024 × 1024 bytes). `0` = unlimited, otherwise 1 to 10240. It is the whole message as sent: attachments grow by about a third when encoded, so 50 MB lets through attachments up to roughly 36 MB. A larger message is refused, so its sender gets a bounce.

### Optional

- `allow_weak_password_schemes` (Boolean) Let mailboxes log in with password hashes Dovecot counts as weak (MD5-crypt and the like, kept from an older server by an import, a restore or a hash copy). Off (default `false`), Dovecot 2.4 refuses those logins - "authentication failed" with the right password. Applies to every mailbox on the server: turn it off again once those people have new passwords (new passwords are always SHA512-crypt). On Dovecot 2.3 it changes nothing (2.3 accepts them anyway).

### Read-Only

- `compression_methods` (List of String) The stored-mail compression methods this server's Dovecot can write - what `apicp_mail_domain.compression` accepts besides `off` (empty while compression is unavailable: the plugin is missing or cannot load). Read-only; compression is set per mail domain. Empty on apicp before v0.8.0.
- `default_max_message_size_mb` (Number) apicp's own default - what the server has until this is set, and what destroying this resource goes back to.
- `id` (String) Always `mail_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_mail_settings.this mail_settings
```
